verification_policy.inner_loop: Run only the closest type, contract, component, repository, or provider check that can falsify the current package.
verification_policy.package_exit: Run the package's focused tests and generated-contract check only.
verification_policy.program_closure: Run one local cross-layer smoke, production frontend and desktop builds, architecture guards and governance.

closure_policy: Retain the completed program documents as the owner-requested construction ledger; source, reproducible checks and current component docs remain architectural truth.
